expectedIssues: Green Bowl Poké card appears twice in the carousel
reportedIssues: The 'Fastest near you' carousel shows two identical cards, both 'Green Bowl Poké' with the same image, 15–25 min and €0.90 delivery. This looks like a duplicated data or rendering bug, and it wastes prime space in a short list.
Secondary text such as the light gray delivery fee lines ('€0.90 delivery'), the search placeholder, and the inactive tab labels has low contrast against the white or light gray backgrounds.

The time badges on the carousel cards sit on the bottom-left edge of the image and overlap the image boundary tightly. The heart icon on the dark ramen image has a low-contrast translucent background. Both look slightly inconsistent.
The food images are flat illustrations rather than real photos, and the poké bowl image is small and off-center within its card. This makes the cards look like placeholders.
